name: Oslo (Norway, 1924–2000)

colors.symbolism: the blue of the city's coat of arms
the silver of the city's coat of arms

description: Four equal horizontal stripes — blue, white, blue and white — in the city's heraldic colours.
history: Adopted in 1924 for the 300th anniversary of Kristiania, as Oslo was then called, and drawn from the blue and silver of the city's arms. It was criticised for resembling the flag of Greece, and was replaced in 2000 when the municipality adopted a new flag bearing the city arms for Oslo's millennium.

features.symbolism: the blue and silver of Oslo's coat of arms
